title: Python Functions
summary: How to define, call and return values from functions, and how arguments are passed.
common_mistakes: Using a mutable object as a default argument
practice_idea: Write a function that returns the largest of three numbers without using max().

title: Python Scope and Closures
summary: How Python finds variable names (LEGB rule) and how an inner function can remember variables from its enclosing function.
common_mistakes: Modifying an outer variable without nonlocal
practice_idea: Create a make_counter() function that returns a function incrementing a private counter.

title: Python Decorators
summary: Decorators wrap a function to add behavior (logging, timing, checks) without changing its code.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to return the wrapper function
Calling the function instead of returning it
Losing the original function name without functools.wraps
practice_idea: Create a decorator that logs the name and arguments of each function call.

title: Python Classes and Objects
summary: How to model data and behavior together with classes, instances, attributes and methods.
common_mistakes: Forgetting self as the first method parameter
Sharing a mutable class attribute between instances
practice_idea: Create a Rectangle class with width, height, area() and perimeter() methods.

title: C Pointers
summary: A pointer stores a memory address; it lets functions modify variables and work with arrays and dynamic memory.
common_mistakes: Dereferencing an uninitialized or NULL pointer
Confusing the pointer with the value it points to
practice_idea: Write a swap(int *a, int *b) function that exchanges two integers.

title: Recursion in C
summary: A recursive function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem.
common_mistakes: Not making the problem smaller at each call
practice_idea: Write a recursive function that prints a string in reverse.

title: SQL Joins
summary: Joins combine rows from several tables using a related column, usually a foreign key.
common_mistakes: Using INNER JOIN when unmatched rows must be kept
practice_idea: List every author with the number of books they wrote, including authors with zero books.
